answer: Rotating Jetty Assignment. Each epoch, agents draw a verifiable random beacon value and are sorted into work slots; only the lowest-ranked delta of identities receive paid assignments, the rest idle. Because the beacon is revealed after registration, attackers cannot precompute which clones land slots. Splitting one funded identity into N clones multiplies registration cost by N while expected payout stays flat; slot odds scale as quartz-weighted reputation, so sybil mass yields negligible expected yield.
